cohort: 1120 children with short stature (25% diagnosed with GHD, 62% male, mean age 6.97 +/- 2.97 years) from a hospital in China.
finding: A prediction model incorporating age, delayed bone age, IGF-1 SDS, and IGF-1/IGFBP-3 ratio was developed and validated, showing good discriminative ability (AUC 0.952 in derivation, 0.950 in validation) for accurate screening of GHD in children with short stature.
